name: annabelle-catgame
description: 🐱 A fun 2D game starring an orange tabby with big green eyes. Single-file HTML5 with two modes (endless run + SNES-style platform). Kid-readable code.

scripts.smoke: node smoke-mechanics.js && node smoke-platform.js && node smoke-mobile-fixed.js && node smoke-fall-physics.js && node smoke-gravity-bg.js && node smoke-mario.js && node smoke-gameover-race.js && node smoke-jump-buff.js
scripts.smoke:all: for f in smoke-mechanics.js smoke-platform.js smoke-mobile-fixed.js smoke-fall-physics.js smoke-gravity-bg.js smoke-mario.js smoke-gameover-race.js smoke-jump-buff.js; do node "$f" || echo "FAIL: $f"; done
